# Hedwig

> A second opinion you ask before your AI agent pays. Hedwig never signs or sends.

- [Home](https://usehedwig.xyz/): what Hedwig is and how to call it.
- [Call Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): add Hedwig to your agent.
- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): install steps for your agent, release v0.4.2.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): when to call the `consult` tool.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
